name: single-shot-software-build
description: Turn a one-line product idea into a complete, running full-stack system in a single orchestrated multi-agent build. The architect expands the brief with taste, freezes a compiler-enforced contract (types + config + design system) after an adversarial pre-freeze gauntlet, product-directs every screen and endpoint in prose, fans implementation out across parallel disjoint-ownership agents (decomposition mechanically verified), hardens through a compile loop, multi-lens review, adversarial verification, and a mechanical gate, then closes the loop with scored product-design and UX judges iterating on the rendered app until it clears the bar.
